issue.title: Add a visible reading-progress bar on blog posts

features.description: Create a ReadingProgress client component that renders a fixed progress bar at the top of the viewport, scoped to scroll depth of the article body. Integrate it into the blog post page only. Must support dark/light theme, prefers-reduced-motion, and aria-hidden accessibility.

subtasks.description: Create ReadingProgress client component with scroll listener scoped to article container, using accent color from Tailwind config, with prefers-reduced-motion support and aria-hidden
Integrate ReadingProgress component into blog post page (src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx), positioned below navbar
